content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NRLM Karnataka to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NRLM Karnataka Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 12th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for the Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have M.Sc. (Agri) or B.Sc. (Agri) with relevant experience, or any Master's degree with 5 years of experience in farm livelihoods.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods position?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Kalaburagi, Karnataka.
